name: Pole test
description: The animal is placed head-upward at the top of a vertical pole and must turn and descend to the base. Assesses bradykinesia and motor coordination, commonly in models of Parkinson's disease.

parameters.label: Pole length
parameters.help: Length of the pole from the top, where the animal is placed, to the base.

parameters.label: Cut-off time
parameters.help: Maximum trial duration; the trial is stopped at this time.

inputEvents.label: Turn completed
inputEvents.definition: The animal has turned to face downward.

inputEvents.label: Base reached
inputEvents.definition: All four paws have reached the base.

inputEvents.label: Fall
inputEvents.definition: The animal falls off the pole.

events.label: Base reached
events.definition: Scored arrival at the base, passed through unchanged.

metrics.label: Time to turn (T-turn)
metrics.description: Time taken to turn head-downward; longer times suggest bradykinesia.
metrics.definition: Time of the turn_complete event, measured from the trial start.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NOT_SCORED) when the event was not scored, or (EVENT_NOT_OBSERVED) when it did not occur.

metrics.label: Total time (T-total)
metrics.description: Time from the start of the trial until the animal reaches the base.
metrics.definition: Time of the base_reached event, measured from the trial start. The cut-off time is not imputed.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NOT_SCORED) when the event was not scored, or (EVENT_NOT_OBSERVED) when it did not occur.

metrics.label: Descent time
metrics.description: Time from completion of the turn to arrival at the base.
metrics.definition: Time from completion of the turn to arrival at the base.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing, for the same reason as the first missing event.

metrics.label: Descent speed
metrics.description: Pole length divided by descent time; lower speeds suggest impaired motor function.
metrics.definition: Pole length divided by descent time.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (ZERO_DENOMINATOR) when the descent time is 0; otherwise missing for the same reason as descent_time_s.

metrics.label: Fall detected
metrics.description: Whether the animal fell off the pole.
metrics.definition: 1 if a fall was recorded; 0 if falls were scored and none occurred.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NOT_SCORED) when falls were not scored.
